mechanism: Build A matches once; use one initial-model A pass for a checked seed, convert the same matches into RF cache format, then refit exact block costs while retaining the seed as a competing plan. Apply only to already A-plus-RF routes; preserve the released RF configuration for each route.
difference_from_old_work: Q/Z profiles show duplicate matching and multiple planning passes. D-only weak seeds lost0.0615pp, but they discarded A match quality as well. This keeps A deep search and its candidate list while removing duplicate RF search and A model iterations. Minimum native byte screen decides whether total time and substantial new Lean migration are worth doing.

attribution.ownership: Original A and RF algorithms retained with attribution; new shared-cache pipeline is a derived composition, not invention of the engines.
